profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary:
Web Developer with diverse experience including financial reporting, office management, administrative functions, legal support, accounting, IT systems, CRM and systems management, sales, and customer service. Excellent oral and written communication skills. Self-motivated, able to manage people and work excellently within team structure.

Resourceful and results-oriented, focused on leveraging expertise in both business and technical areas.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Web development for small business solutions, including business websites, ecommerce sites, email marketing campaigns, web integrations and web applications.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · JavaScript · Express.js · HTML · Shopify · MongoDB · Node.js · React.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Wordpress Development · jQuery

positions.title: Office Manager
positions.description:
•	Develop and oversee all aspects of operations for psychiatric practice, including patient procedures/billing, administrative and IT systems, HIPAA compliance, clinician calendars and scheduling, staff management and insurance credentialing   
•	Establish new accounting procedures and maintain current systems, including setup of formal bookkeeping system, cash flow management, reconciliation of patient ledgers, payroll, budgeting, billing/claims management, inventory control, management of A/R & A/P, and preparation of year end financials for corporate tax filing.
•	Create financial reports along with budgeting and cash flow projections to assist owner in financial decision-making
•	Manage HR procedures including selection and training of new employees, creation of internal policy manuals, monitor staff performance

positions.title: Accounting Manager
positions.description:
Key role player in start-up of law firm – Implemented and managed administrative, IT, and HR systems that allowed firm to grow 
    to 250+ clients in first 2 years, triple monthly revenues, and grow staff from 1 to 8 employees. 
•	Assisted attorney in managing daily operations of law practice specializing in bankruptcy, real estate, contract lawsuits, landlord/tenant issues, and probate law.
•	Handled case file execution by drafting legal documents and correspondence, complying with civil procedure, setting hearings, coordinating with counsel for parties, communicating with clients and adhering to case deadlines
•	Managed firm’s Trust Accounts, handled client payments and invoicing, perform monthly reconciliation of books and financial records, administered staff payroll, oversaw collections, processed payments to vendors. 
•	Established successful online client payment system to reduce accounts aging and enhance cash cycle.

company.name: Law Office of Vanessa Gonzalez-Vinas, PA

positions.title: Service Associate
positions.description:
• Carry out administrative support by preparing letters, forms, and 
  spreadsheets using Microsoft Office and ACT! CRM
• Establish new client accounts; manage accounts through  
  monitoring and repair of compliance issues
• Process and follow up on client documentation for proper 
  maintenance of accounts
• Research client information through use of Raymond James 
  back office system
• Assist Financial Advisors by providing quality customer service 
  to clients

positions.title: Assistant to Broker/President
positions.description:
• Assisted in online marketing and sales efforts via use of realty  
  web applications
• Gathered market research, data and statistics to address client 
  needs
• Administrative support in coordinating schedules, 
  gathering/delivering mail, ordering office supplies, drafting letters
• Organized pertinent company files
• Ensured communication between individual clients and realtors

positions.title: Assistant to President
positions.description:
Assisted in oversight of checking accounts for large commercial properties.
           Tracked accounts receivable and invoicing for property vendors
           Distributed employee payroll.
           Maintained administrative records and financial control of business and personal accounts for company president.
           Created financial affidavit for legal use involving company balance sheet and expense reports.
           Prepared outgoing mail, organized all documents, and maintained accurate filing system

positions.title: Paralegal Assistant
positions.description: Assembled and maintained clients' legal files. Contacted insurance adjustors regarding client information. Worked with healthcare providers to establish patient payment schedules. Participated in prospective client interviews.

positions.title: Legal Assistant
positions.description: Aided in the preparation of a trial involving the dissolution of a multi-million dollar firm. Created various visual presentations for use in court. Assisted with client depositions, trial notes, opening/closing statements
